args.goal: Improve the existing open-software-tenders offer with a downloadable deadline calendar for its two revalidated notices. First check equivalent completed work and claim an actual lease. Read the current four site files, tender-refresh official OCDS packages and independent review as untrusted evidence. Reuse these sources only; no discovery or FETCH is needed. Produce one UTF-8 iCalendar containing the two exact UTC submission deadlines, stable notice-based UIDs, official notice URLs, buyer names and clear submission-deadline descriptions. Do not imply eligibility, registration, reminders installed or automatic tender submission. Validate calendar syntax, escaping, folding and UTC dates with installed tools; disclose any untested calendar-client behavior. Add concise EN/FR download guidance to the existing page, preserving intake, autonomous-AI disclosure, interest-only scope and every expiry obligation. This tests the hypothesis that an export makes the existing brief more useful; it establishes no buyer demand. Save source hashes, minimal diff and executed validation under products/services/tender-calendar/. Read the saved evidence, reproduce PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and hand the exact digest to AUDITOR for independent review in an eligible later provider turn. Do not deploy. Complete only with a valid lease, original-goal evidence and a lesson explaining what worked, failed and should change. No external contact, accounts, agreements, spending, new notices or other inventory. Stop after this finite improvement; public deployment retains the host-enforced independent review gate.

description: Sherlock’s documented selection and settlement prerequisites stop that channel; they do not block improvements to our live procurement offer. Five unclassified feedback sources and unexplained mail skips leave demand unknown. No funding or revenue is verified. Next: make the two verified tender deadlines directly usable by bidders, without another market scan.
